title: refactor(driver-sql): put SqlDriver into facade form with the sql-driver codemod (sql-driver.ts 18,334 -> 10,979, body-identical)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB2J1rGmLUVawKQeMT3jK9KS)_

Part of #30105

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`（#29520 的试点脚本）加上 `engine.ts` / `protocol.ts` 已有的门面层，并重新生成 `sql-driver.ts`。`SqlDriver` 成为门面：158 个方法体移入 21 个无状态 facet 类（静态方法，`this` 是一个具名 host），类上各留一行 `.call(xHost.of(this), …)` 委派；私有方法的文档块随方法体移走（21 个），公开和受保护方法的文档块留在门面；状态全部留在门面。生成文件未手改。
- 为什么改：#29465 大文件拆分，裁决 6632500982 把门面形态（6624258595）扩展到本文件；`.d.ts` 门槛按 6624345766 取「公开面相等」。
- 风险与回滚：纯搬移。158/158 个方法体逐字节等于 base，撤销拆分逐字节重建 base 的 `sql-driver.ts`；两次 `--write` 输出树 sha256 相同。公开面 `.d.ts` 相等（对照抓到）。driver-sql 测试 base 与 head 都是 3,859 通过；turso、sqlite-wasm 两个子类驱动计数不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① 「Facade reading」一节的 28 条例外（其中哪些是 codemod 限制、需另立卡）；② codemod 的 `CLASS_HEAD_SECTION` 和新加的 `logDurabilityFailure` pin；③ `check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs` 新登记的 4 个模块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 21510bba`，预期 `158/158 moved bodies identical to base`、`sql-driver.ts 18334 -> 10979 lines`，退出码 0；`--self-test` 67 例通过；`node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs` 退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：改动超过 3,000 行（+4,990 / −3,121，含生成文件），需您批准后落地，并在您定的窗口冻结 `sql-driver.ts`；本 PR 保持草稿。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`** gains the facade layer `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` carries (#30012, #30083):
  - Each section module's moved bodies become the static methods of one stateless facet class (`sql-driver-crud.ts` → `CrudFacet`), at class indentation, unedited. Their `this` is one named host interface typed AS the class members (`SqlDriver['x']`), so a private member is reached like a public one.
  - The stub on the class keeps its modifiers and signature byte-for-byte (only `async` is dropped) and makes one call: `return CrudFacet.x.call(crudHost.of(this), …)`. Each host is built once per driver by a factory the class's static block installs into `sql-driver-facet-hosts.ts` (types-only module). Methods go as closures called on the driver at call time, so a subclass override or an instance spy is still the one reached; `getBuilder` goes as a bound getter (`BOUND_HOST_METHODS`) so `check-tenant-chokepoint` still counts the binding in the moved body; fields and accessors go as getters, assigned fields with a setter.
  - Private statics the moved bodies read go through `SqlDriverStatics`, which a facet module imports AS `SqlDriver` (private-static-through-host, 6624174693).
  - Docblock ownership (6624345766 item 1): a private method's docblock moves with its body; a public or protected one stays on the facade and the facet member carries a one-line placeholder pointing back.
  - The members above the first banner form one more section, the class head (`CLASS_HEAD_SECTION` → `sql-driver-class-head.ts`). Three sections whose hand-series seam exists already take a `-section` suffix; `sql-driver-deferred-ddl.ts` and `sql-driver-transactions-section.ts` are new.
  - No import prune: driver-sql compiles without `noUnusedLocals`, so an import only a moved body reads stays, as the pilot left them.
  - The pilot's `--dts` byte-equality reading is dropped: a facade cannot meet it by construction (the bundled `.d.ts` prints every private member). The bar is now the public-surface reading below, taken outside `scripts/` (6441032442 item 3).
  - `parameter-shadows` now fires only for a parameter named like the stub's facet class or host variable (it freed 4 methods).
  - One new `PATH_READER_PINS` row, `logDurabilityFailure` (see readers below).
  - `--self-test`: 67 cases in 5 pinned batteries (class-head section, the bound getter and two banner refusals added; the import-prune battery removed).
- **The generated split** is `--write` on the unsplit `sql-driver.ts` of `21510bba` (the parent of the pilot's landing), unedited. 158/254 methods move into 21 facet modules; `sql-driver.ts` goes 18,334 → 10,979 lines (12,460 on `main`). The leaf `sql-driver-top-level.ts` is byte-identical to `main`. `index.ts` re-exports none of the new modules.
- **`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`**: the `sql-driver.ts` / `SqlDriver` facade row (card #30105) and 28 exception rows, all carded #30020.
- **By-path readers** (6597555122 item 3):
  - `check-durability-degradation-log-level` judges the two MySQL widening catches that stay on the class (`migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`, `migrateMysqlTimeColumns`) by following `this.logDurabilityFailure(…)` to its body in the same file. A one-call stub there cannot be followed, so both read "swallowed, no log" (measured red). The helper is pinned to stay rather than widening the gate's same-file helper walk across files; the gate's readings are then equal to base.
  - `check-tenant-chokepoint`'s `DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS` names the four new `sql-driver-*.ts` modules (its self-test requires every scanned file to be declared).
  - Every other reader of `sql-driver.ts` by path (the `packages/cli` generate pins, `check-keyed-text-bounds`, `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`, the liveness and checklist anchors, the ADR anchors) reads text the codemod keeps on the class through its existing pin and needle tables, and passes unchanged.
- **No changeset**, as #29598 and #30012 (both `skip-changeset`): no published behaviour or surface changes.

## Tests

No test file changes. The suites below ran at base `f68b47ca` and at head; the counts are equal.

| Suite | Base | Head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| driver-sql (`vitest run`) | 238 files passed, 12 skipped; 3,859 passed, 216 skipped | the same |
| driver-turso (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 96 files; 2,496 passed, 34 skipped | 96 files; 2,496 passed, 34 skipped |
| driver-sqlite-wasm (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 40 files; 750 passed | 40 files; 750 passed |
| cli by-path pins (9 files: generate-* pins, `clean.operator-text-21418`) | 9 files; 131 passed | 9 files; 131 passed |
| types / metadata / metadata-protocol by-path tests, spec `check-liveness.test` | 22 / 11 / 28 / 74 passed | 22 / 11 / 28 / 74 passed |

## Acceptance notes

- Phase 0: this PR stays a draft. It is over the 3,000-line human-merge threshold, so it lands on a maintainer approval, after `sql-driver.ts` is frozen for a window. At landing the script runs on the latest `main`'s unsplit text (regenerate, never rebase, ruling A on #29465).
- Codemod-limit exception rows the seat may card separately (the rest are state-owning, #30020): the five accessors (the codemod moves methods, not accessors); `rotateShards` / `ensureRotation` (a computed parameter default stays in the byte-for-byte signature); the path-reader pins (`ensureShardTable`, `initObjects`, `migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`, `migrateMysqlTimeColumns`, `resolveWithheldFilterRefusal`, `createAuditTimestampColumn`, `varcharColumnChars`, `createColumn`, `logDurabilityFailure`), which move once their readers read the facet modules; and the `field-call: knex`, `inferred-return-type` and `comment-in-parameters` stays.
- `dts-public.mjs`'s built-in `--private-control` fails on this dist: it deletes the first `private x;` line but leaves that member's docblock, which then attaches to the next (public) member. Dropping the whole private member with its docblock passes (reading below).

## Verification

| Determinism | | two `--write` runs: output tree sha256 `eab675141cad9efdb5217f65f044a246474c973777c575d9f5ee00b8c63d8154` both times; regeneration reproduces the committed tree |
| `driver-sql typecheck` | exit 0 | exit 0 |
| `check:facade-delegation-only` (+ `--self-test` 36) | | exit 0: `SqlDriver` 352 members, 244 delegations, 80 fields, 28 named exceptions |

### `.d.ts`: ruling 6624345766 item 1, "public surface EQUAL"

Read with `dts-public.mjs` (project files `issue-29985/dts-public.mjs`, sha256 `211b32062250606e658acd7fb8880e0079b4043121fb7b970c658b4b57bf5020`, the reading #29985 used). driver-sql's `.d.ts` build is deterministic on both sides (two builds each, byte-identical), so one pair is read.

| Reading | `index.d.ts` | `index.d.mts` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| raw (sha256 base `69d9162d…` / head `fac28979…`) | differs (private members) | differs |
| private members cut, union order, second normalisation | **equal** (106 / 106 statements) | **equal** |
| declared surface | equal | equal |

- The control that edits one public docblock is caught.
- Dropping one whole private member (`fileColumnsMovedDeclared` with its docblock) passes.
- The facet classes and hosts do not appear in the `.d.ts`.

The 28 exception rows (all #30020):

| Reason | Members |
|:--|:--|
| state: constructor logic, field / static initializers holding arrows | `constructor`, `logger`, `static DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` |
| accessor (codemod moves methods only) | `get supports`, `get insertReturnsStoredRows`, `get dateGranularityCapabilities`, `get supportsWalJournal`, `get dialectName` |
| a computed parameter default | `rotateShards`, `ensureRotation` |
| path-reader | `logDurabilityFailure`, `ensureShardTable`, `initObjects`, `migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`, `migrateMysqlTimeColumns`, `resolveWithheldFilterRefusal`, `createAuditTimestampColumn`, `varcharColumnChars`, `createColumn` |
| field-call: knex | `listPhysicalColumns`, `getBuilder`, `explainUnkeyableTextColumn`, `explainHashShadowDuplicate` |
| inferred-return-type | `applyFilters`, `applyFilterCondition`, `ensureDatabaseExists`, `createDatabase` |
| comment-in-parameters | `assertOperatorAppliesToColumn` |

The 78 hand-series stubs stay as they were (their modules are the hand series', not facets) and read as delegations.
